violation_type.title: Parent Provided Meals/Snacks - Nutritional Value (26 TAC §744.2409(a)(2))
violation_type.typical_finding: Some children in care were allowed to bring/eat snack provided by parents. There was no documentation on file that parents providing snack understood the operation is not responsible for its nutritional value or for meeting the child's daily food needs.
